verses.ar: رَاعَتْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَا أَنْبَاءُ بِعْثَتِهِ ۞ كَنَبْأَةٍ أَجْفَلَتْ غُفْلاً مِنَ الْغَنَمِ
verses.tr: Rāʿat qulūbal ʿidā anbāʾu biʿthatihi · Kanabʾatin ajfalat ghuflan minal ghanami
verses.en: The tidings of his sending struck terror into the hearts of the enemies, like a sudden sound that scatters heedless sheep.

verses.ar: مَا زَالَ يَلْقَاهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُعْتَرَكٍ ۞ حَتَّى حَكَوْا بِالْقَنَا لَحْمًا عَلٰى وَضَمِ
verses.tr: Mā zāla yalqāhumu fī kulli muʿtarakin · Ḥattā ḥakaw bil qanā laḥman ʿalā waḍami
verses.en: He kept meeting them on every field of battle, until the spears left them like meat on a butcher's block.

verses.ar: وَدُّوا الْفِرَارَ فَكَادُوا يَغْبِطُونَ بِهِ ۞ أَشْلاَءَ شَالَتْ مَعَ الْعِقْبَانِ وَالرَّخَمِ
verses.tr: Waddul firāra fakādū yaghbiṭūna bihi · Ashlāʾa shālat maʿal ʿiqbāni war rakhami
verses.en: They longed to flee, till they almost envied the torn limbs borne aloft by the eagles and the vultures.

verses.ar: تَمْضِي اللَّيَالِي وَلاَ يَدْرُونَ عِدَّتَهَا ۞ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنْ لَيَالِي الْأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ
verses.tr: Tamḍil layālī wa lā yadrūna ʿiddatahā · Mā lam takun min layālil ash-huril ḥurumi
verses.en: The nights passed and they could not reckon their number — unless they were nights of the Sacred Months.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّمَا الدِّينُ ضَيْفٌ حَلَّ سَاحَتَهُمْ ۞ بِكُلِّ قَرْمٍ إِلَى لَحْمِ الْعِدَا قَرِمِ
verses.tr: Ka annamad dīnu ḍayfun ḥalla sāḥatahum · Bi kulli qarmin ilā laḥmil ʿidā qarimi
verses.en: As if the Religion were a guest that alighted in their courtyard, borne by every chieftain hungry for the flesh of the foe.

verses.ar: يَجُرُّ بَحْرَ خَمِيسٍ فَوْقَ سَابِحَةٍ ۞ يَرْمِى بِمَوْجٍ مِنَ الْأَبْطَالِ مُلْتَطِمِ
verses.tr: Yajurru baḥra khamīsin fawqa sābiḥatin · Yarmī bi mawjin minal abṭāli multaṭimi
verses.en: Leading a sea of soldiers upon swift steeds, casting forth wave upon crashing wave of heroes.

verses.ar: مِنْ كُلِّ مُنْتَدَبٍ لِلّٰهِ مُحْتَسِبٍ ۞ يَسْطُو بِمُسْتَأْصِلٍ لِلكُفْرِ مُصْطَلِمِ
verses.tr: Min kulli muntadabin liLlāhi muḥtasibin · Yasṭū bimustaʾṣilin lil kufri muṣṭalimi
verses.en: Every one of them answering Allah's call and seeking His reward, striking to uproot disbelief and wipe it out.

verses.ar: حَتىَّ غَدَتْ مِلَّةُ الْإِسْلاَمِ وَهْيَ بِهِمْ ۞ مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرْبَتِهَا مَوْصُولَةَ الرَّحِمِ
verses.tr: Ḥatta ghadat millatul islāmi wahya bihim · Min baʿdi ghurbatihā mawṣūlatar rahimi
verses.en: Until, through them, the community of Islam became — after its estrangement — a kinship rejoined.

verses.ar: مَكْفُولَةً أَبَدًا مِنْهُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَبٍ ۞ وَخَيْرِ بَعْلٍ فَلَمْ تَيْتَمْ وَلَمْ تَئِمِ
verses.tr: Makfūlatan abadan minhum bi khayri abin · Wa khayri baʿlin fa lam taytam wa lam taʾimi
verses.en: Forever safeguarded by them, through the best of fathers and the best of husbands, so it was neither orphaned nor widowed.

verses.ar: هُمُ الْجِبَالُ فَسَلْ عَنْهُمْ مُصَادِمَهُمْ ۞ مَاذَا رَأَى مِنْهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُصْطَدَمِ
verses.tr: Humul jibālu fasal ʿanhum muṣādimahum · Mādhā raʾā minhumu fī kulli muṣṭadami
verses.en: They were mountains — so ask of them the one who clashed with them what he witnessed of them in every collision.

verses.ar: وَسَلْ حُنَيْنًا وَسَلْ بَدْرًا وَسَلْ أُحُدًا ۞ فُصُولَ حَتْفٍ لَهُمْ أَدْهَى مِنَ الْوَخَمِ
verses.tr: Wa sal ḥunaynan wa sal badran wa sal uḥudan · Fuṣūla ḥatfin lahum adʾhā minal wakhami
verses.en: Ask Ḥunayn, and ask Badr, and ask Uḥud — seasons of death for them, more grievous than any plague.

verses.ar: الْمُصْدِرِي الْبِيضِ حُمْرًا بَعْدَ مَا وَرَدَتْ ۞ مِنَ الْعِدَا كُلَّ مُسْوَدٍّ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ
verses.tr: Almuṣdiril bīḍi ḥumran baʿda mā waradat · Minal ʿidā kulla muswaddin minal limami
verses.en: They drew back their white blades stained red, after they had gone in among the enemy's every dark head of hair.

verses.ar: وَالكَاتِبِينَ بِسُمْرِ الْخَطِّ مَا تَرَكَتْ ۞ أَقْلاَمُهُمْ حَرْفَ جِسْمٍ غَيْرَ مُنَعَجِمِ
verses.tr: Wal kātibīna bi sumril khaṭṭi mā tarakat · Aqlāmuhum ḥarfa jismin ghayra munʿajimi
verses.en: Writing with the brown shafts of their spears, their pens left no letter of a body without its mark.

verses.ar: شَاكِي السِّلاَحِ لَهُمْ سِيمَا تُمَيِّزُهُمْ ۞ وَالوَرْدُ يَمْتَازُ بِالسِّيمَا عَنِ السَّلَمِ
verses.tr: Shākis silāḥi lahum sīmā tumayyizuhum · Wal wardu yamtāzu bis sīmā ʿanis salami
verses.en: Fully armed, they bore a mark that set them apart — as the rose is set apart by its mark from the acacia.

verses.ar: تُهْدِي إِلَيْكَ رِيَاحُ النَّصْرِ نَشْرَهُمُ ۞ فَتَحْسَبُ الزَّهْرَ فِي الْأَكْمَامِ كُلَّ كَمِي
verses.tr: Tuhdī ilayka riyāḥun naṣri nashrahumu · Fataḥsabuz zahra fīl akmāmi kulla kamī
verses.en: The winds of victory bring you their fragrance, till you would take every armoured hero for a flower in its bud.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ فِي ظُهُورِ الْخَيْلِ نَبْتُ رُبًا ۞ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَزْمِ لاَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحُزُمِ
verses.tr: Ka annahum fī ẓuhūril khayli nabtu ruban · Min shiddatil ḥazmi lā min shiddatil ḥuzumi
verses.en: On the backs of their steeds they seemed like plants rooted on a hill — held firm by the strength of resolve, not the strength of saddle-girths.

verses.ar: طَارَتْ قُلُوبُ الْعِدَا مِنْ بَأْسِهِمْ فَرَقًا ۞ فَمَا تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْبَهْمِ وَالبُهُمِ
verses.tr: Ṭārat qulūbul ʿidā min baʾsihim faraqan · Famā tufarriqu baynal bahmi wal buhami
verses.en: The hearts of the foe took flight in terror at their might, so that they could not tell the lambs from the armoured warriors.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ تَكُنْ بِرَسُولِ اللّٰهِ نُصْرَتُهُ ۞ إِنْ تَلْقَهُ الْأُسْدُ فِي آجَامِهَا تَجِمِ
verses.tr: Wa man takun birasūliLlāhi nuṣratuhu · In talqahul usdu fī ājāmihā tajimi
verses.en: Whoever's help comes through the Emissary of Allah — should the lions meet him in their thickets, they fall silent and cower.

verses.ar: وَلَنْ تَرَى مِنْ وَليٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْتَصِرٍ ۞ بِهِ وَلاَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْقَصِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lan tarā min waliyyin ghayri muntaṣirin · Bihi wa lā min ʿaduwwin ghayri munqasimi
verses.en: You will see no friend of his who is not made victorious through him, and no foe who is not broken.

verses.ar: أَحَلَّ أُمَّتَهُ فِي حِرْزِ مِلَّتِهِ ۞ كَاللَّيْثِ حَلَّ مَعَ الْأَشْبَالِ فِي أَجَمِ
verses.tr: Aḥalla ummatahu fī ḥirzi millatihi · Kal laythi ḥalla maʿal ashbāli fī ajami
verses.en: He settled his community within the stronghold of his faith, as the lion settles with its cubs in the thicket.

verses.ar: كَمْ جَدَّلَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللّٰهِ مِنْ جَدَلٍ ۞ فِيهِ وَكَمْ خَصَمَ الْبُرْهَانُ مِنْ خَصِمِ
verses.tr: Kam jaddalat kalimātuLlāhi min jadilin · Fīhi wa kam khaṣamal burhānu min khaṣimi
verses.en: How many a disputer the words of Allah have thrown down concerning him, and how many an adversary the proof has defeated!

verses.ar: كَفَاكَ بِالْعِلْمِ فِي الْأُمِّيِّ مُعْجِزَةً ۞ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَالتَّأْدِيبِ فِي الْيُتُمِ
verses.tr: Kafāka bil ʿilmi fīl ummiyyi muʿjizatan · Fīl jāhiliyyati wat taʾdībi fīl yutumi
verses.en: Knowledge in one unlettered is miracle enough for you — in an age of ignorance — as is refinement in one orphaned.
